config_name: MacBook Pro 14-inch — M5 Max 40-core GPU, 48GB RAM, 2TB SSD

specs.keyboard_notes: Magic Keyboard, Touch ID, Force Touch trackpad

battery.notes: Up to 20h video / 13h web claimed; 72.4Wh. NBC: battery dropped ~10% during native Cyberpunk play; peak load exceeds the 97W input cap.

price.notes: Verified on apple.com/ca buy page (see research/parts/apple/NOTES.md).

reviews.quote: the 14-inch chassis and the cooling simply cannot handle the M5 Max adequately... serious thermal throttling... very inconsistent CPU performance... We definitely think the M5 Max is a better option for the larger 16-inch model.
exceptional build quality... all-aluminum unibody (same chassis, M5 model tested)

praises: Full 40-core GPU and 48GB unified memory — the most GPU power Apple ships in a sub-1.7 kg laptop
M5 Max GPU is roughly RTX 5070-class; native Cyberpunk 2077 runs on it (NBC gaming tests)
Excellent chassis, TB5 ports, best-in-class speakers in a compact body (NBC verdict)
48GB comfortably runs 20-32B quantized local LLMs plus creative apps (unified-memory advantage)
Mini-LED XDR panel with matte option still among the best (NBC)
complaints: Serious thermal throttling in the 14-inch chassis; very inconsistent CPU performance (NBC)
96W adapter insufficient and input capped at 97W — battery drains under gaming/load even plugged in (NBC)
Fans get loud because power limits are set high (NBC)
You pay $900 CAD more than the 32-core tier but the chassis throttles much of that GPU away (NBC)
NBC explicitly recommends buying the 16-inch for the M5 Max

design_philosophy: The halo configuration of the 14-inch line: Apple's strongest chip squeezed into the smallest Pro chassis. It is the ultimate compact workstation on paper, though NBC's testing shows the cooling cannot fully cash the M5 Max's cheque — buyers get portability first, sustained peak second.
rating_notes: Closest match to the directly tested unit in NBC's 90.2% review of the MacBook Pro 14 M5 Max (40-core GPU). Thermals penalised (5.5) per NBC's severe-throttling finding, per NOTES calibration; gaming ~4.5-5 per NOTES (M5 Max GPU ≈ RTX 5070 class).
